item.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Chicago
item.description:
Join us to shape the future!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

Working at Teamtailor means being part of a dynamic, fast-paced tech company that values impact and responsibility. Our workplace fosters an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully to the growth of the company. 🎉🥳

Building a diverse team with a wide range of experiences, skills, and backgrounds has always been central to Teamtailor’s mission, and it remains a strength today. We welcome all individuals who share our vision and are committed to contributing to our collective success. Join us in helping companies and people communicate in more meaningful ways to make life-changing decisions together.👫

Why SaaS AEs love it here:

You know the drill — you've sold SaaS before, you're good at it, and you're tired of environments that feel like a grind. Here's what's different at Teamtailor Chicago:

  • A full sales cycle you actually own - You prospect, run the demo, negotiate, and close. Full autonomy, full commission credit.

  • Real hybrid, not fake flexible - In office Tuesday–Thursday at our Chicago flagship HQ, work from home Monday and Friday. You get face time with a genuinely fun team and two days a week to lock in and sell without commute drag.

  • Uncapped earnings, no ceiling games - Competitive base + uncapped commission.

  • A market leader, not a "maybe it'll work out" startup - 13,000+ customers, 200,000+ users, 90 countries. You're selling something companies already trust, which means shorter sales cycles and warmer conversations.

  • A team that celebrates wins loudly - Our guiding stars are to be different, personal, and kind — and that shows up in how we hit quota together, not against each other. Deal closed? Bell rings, team cheers, coffee's on us. ☕️

What you'll be doing:

  • Owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close — sourcing leads via cold outreach, LinkedIn, and social selling, then running meetings, negotiating, and signing new business.

  • Consistently hitting (and beating) monthly sales targets.

  • Teaming up with Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success to keep deals moving and customers thrilled.

  • Staying sharp — leveling up on product knowledge, industry trends, and your own sales craft.

  • Bringing your energy and ideas to the team, because we build this culture together.

What you bring:

  • 6+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience (HR tech/ATS experience is a big plus, but not required).

  • A track record of managing pipelines with real discipline — you forecast accurately and don't let deals go cold.

  • Comfortable with sales tools (Salesforce, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Cognism, Apollo, Slack, Notion).

  • A genuine drive to hunt for new business and close it — you like the chase as much as the win.

  • The relationship-building instincts to turn a first call into a long-term customer.

What we offer:

  • The chance to sell a category-leading employer branding and recruitment platform. 🥰

  • Competitive salary + uncapped commission. 💵

  • Real career growth in a fast-scaling company, with training and support that actually helps. 🎗️

  • A talented, supportive team that has each other's back. 🎤

  • A true hybrid setup at our flagship North America HQ in Chicago Downtown — in office Tue/Wed/Thu. 🏙️

  • A culture built on being different, personal, and kind — with genuinely good vibes, not just a ping-pong table. 🎉

If this opportunity excites you, we look forward to receiving your application!

item.title: SMB Account Executive
item.description:
Join us to shape the future!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

Working at Teamtailor means being part of a dynamic, fast-paced tech company that values impact and responsibility. Our workplace fosters an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully to the growth of the company. 🎉🥳

Building a diverse team with a wide range of experiences, skills, and backgrounds has always been central to Teamtailor’s mission, and it remains a strength today. We welcome all individuals who share our vision and are committed to contributing to our collective success. Join us in helping companies and people communicate in more meaningful ways to make life-changing decisions together.👫

We are now seeking to add a SMB Account Executive to our team in Sydney.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales targets.

  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing deals, including identifying and qualifying prospects, scheduling and conducting customer meetings, negotiating proposals, and securing new business.

  • Source and qualify leads through outreach methods like cold calling, cold emailing, and using social networks such as LinkedIn to identify potential clients.

  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams such as Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success.

  • Demonstrate a growth mindset by continuously learning about our product, internal processes, and industry.

  • Contribute ideas, feedback, and support to your peers.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Uses pattern recognition to stay on top of their pipeline, forecast accurately and spot opportunities early.

  • Has 1–3 years B2B sales experience, ideally in SaaS or HR platforms.

  • Has experience selling into SMB accounts (approx. 0–500 employees).

  • Is strategically curious — always looking to understand the market and find the next opportunity.

  • Is passionate about winning new business and opening up new territories.

  • Has experience selling into Talent and HR teams.

  • Communicates clearly, negotiates well and knows how to read a room.

  • Builds strong, lasting relationships with prospects and clients.

  • Consistently hits or exceeds quota.

  • Focuses energy where it actually moves the needle.

  • Is comfortable using Salesforce, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Slack and Notion.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to sell a leading employer branding and recruitment platform. 🥰

  • A competitive salary uncapped earning potential. 💵

  • Professional growth in a fast-growing environment, with ongoing training & support.🎗️

  • The opportunity to collaborate with a talented and supportive team.🎤

If this opportunity excites you, we look forward to receiving your application!

item.title: Customer Success Manager - Finnish speaking
item.description:
Let's build the future together!

Teamtailor is an Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, and 250,000 users in 90 countries around the world 🌏.

Working at Teamtailor means working at a young, international, and fast-paced tech company that offers an ideal workplace for those who want to have a real impact on the growth of an organization and are craving responsibilities. It also means having lots of fun 🥳.

Building a diverse team with various backgrounds and expertise is at the core of Teamtailor since its very beginning and is truly part of its strength today! There are no typical profiles, each and every team member shares our vision and wants to be part of its success.


That's why we're expanding our Customer Success department and looking for our next Customer Success Manager. Our mission is to have the most satisfied customers, and we are looking for a strong relationship-builder to join our team and take care of our clients 🙌🏼

The Customer Success Manager owns a portfolio of customers and is responsible for building strong, long-term relationships that drive adoption, satisfaction, and growth. This role exists to ensure every customer experiences the full value of Teamtailor, helping them achieve their hiring and employer branding goals while contributing to retention, expansion, and advocacy.

Act as trusted advisors, proactive, strategic, and consultative, ensuring our customers’ success is our success.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of customers across their lifecycle, from Onboarding to Success, as well as renewal and upsell/expansion.

  • Lead onboarding and implementation to ensure customers are set up for success and adopting best practices.

  • Build strong, consultative relationships to deeply understand customer goals and align Teamtailor’s solutions to their needs.

  • Drive product adoption by providing strategic guidance, training, and continuous education.

  • Monitor customer health metrics (e.g., NPS, Health Score, risk & growth signals) to proactively address risks and ensure satisfaction.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams like Product Specialists, Support, Onboarding Specialists, Integrations, and Sales to deliver a seamless experience.

  • Identify and execute upsell and expansion opportunities to grow accounts and increase value.

  • Renew contracts and lead negotiations with a consultative, win-win approach.

  • Collect and share customer feedback to inform product improvements and internal processes.

  • Support other CSMs by role modeling best practices and demonstrating strong communication and ownership.

As a Customer Success Manager at Teamtailor, you will be offered:

  • Responsibility for your own customer base

  • Incredible development opportunities

  • The opportunity to work with the market's best product

  • Fixed salary with commission benefits

  • Be part of a great multicultural team.

Is this you?

  • Proven experience in Customer Success, Account Management, HR/recruitment, or a similar client-facing role in a SaaS environment

  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills (verbal & written)

  • Experience in leading projects

  • Proactive, goal-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Experience with renewals, upselling, and customer retention strategies

  • Strategic, consultative approach with strong problem-solving skills

  • High emotional intelligence, empathy, and adaptability in fast-paced environments

  • Have the mindset of being willing to learn and try new things

  • Fluent in English and Finnish, both in writing and communication.

We value your personality and believe you're passionate about your work, ambitious, and working hard to reach your goals!

Interested? 😃
